title: Minecraft Replace Biomes Misc
description: Replaces a specified portion of one or more Minecraft biomes.

replacements.title: Replacements
replacements.description:
List of biome replacement configurations. Retroactively adding a new replacement to the front of this list will cause the world generation to change. Please add any new replacements to the end of the list.

Properties:
• amount (float)
• dimension (string)
• noise_frequency_scale (float)
• targets

defaultSnippets.label: Biome Replacement Misc
defaultSnippets.description: Represents the replacement information used to determine the placement of the overriding biome.

misc_biome_replacement.title: Biome Replacement Misc
misc_biome_replacement.description: Represents the replacement information used to determine the placement of the overriding biome.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Noise value used to determine whether or not the replacement is attempted, similar to a percentage. Must be in the range (0.0, 1.0].

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: Dimension in which this replacement can happen. Must be 'minecraft:overworld'.

noise_frequency_scale.title: Noise Frequency Scale
noise_frequency_scale.description: Scaling value used to alter the frequency of replacement attempts. A lower frequency will mean a bigger contiguous biome area that occurs less often. A higher frequency will mean smaller contiguous biome areas that occur more often. Must be in the range (0.0, 100.0].

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Biomes that are going to be replaced by the overriding biome. Target biomes must not contain namespaces.
